title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.71
summary: Start 26 cameras fairly in the background with short first attempts, then deferred full media fallback and per-camera timing metrics.
changes: Bound first cold-start HLS media wait to 20 seconds per candidate
Defer expensive ONVIF, encoder, alternate-profile and snapshot fallback attempts until each camera got a first chance
Keep four simultaneous starts, per-camera serialization and existing restart/backoff safety
Record queue wait and active startup durations by camera without credentials
Preserve legacy camera, recording, motion, HLS and fixed go2rtc broker behavior
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.71
description: Fair, bounded 26-camera background bootstrap without increasing concurrency, while preserving full recorder/motion fallback.
releaseNotes: Direct upgrade from 2.20.32. 26 cameras receive a bounded 20-second first media attempt; failed profiles and snapshot recovery run in a second round after all cameras were admitted. Four start slots retained, with queue and active start time diagnostics. No database, camera settings, recordings, motion, patched go2rtc or .env changes.
